svg.text: Pearson r on overlapping trade-days (pairwise dropna) - Generated 2026-06-20 - TXF1 Strategy Lab
Diagonal = self-correlation (greyed) - Bold border: |r| > 0.7 - Dashed border: r < -0.3 (hedge)
n = overlapping trade-days used per pair (pairwise dropna). Daily PnL in NTD, before fees/slippage applied at strategy level.
